title: SkyrimNet MiniGame
tagline: Nine table games with the NPCs around you: Reversi, Checkers, Gomoku, Liar's Dice, Shut the Box, Yacht, Blackjack, Cribbage and Texas Hold'em. Your opponents talk about the game and remember it.
description:
Play table games with the people around you. Open the menu, pick a game and your opponents from the NPCs nearby, and play on a board drawn over the game. SkyrimNet gives your opponents a voice: they talk about the game as it goes, know how it stands, and remember it afterwards.

### Games

- **Reversi** (Othello) against one NPC, at four strengths, with legal-move hints.
- **Liar's Dice** against one to three NPCs. Everyone hides five dice under a cup, ones are wild; in turn you raise the bid on the whole table's dice or call the last bid a lie. Once you are out, the others play on while you watch.
- **Shut the Box** against one to three NPCs. Roll the dice and shut the numbered tiles that add up to the roll. The tiles left open are your score, and the lowest score wins; shutting every tile wins at once.
- **Blackjack** against one to three NPCs. Choose who deals when the game starts, you or one of them; the dealer stays the same until the game ends, holds no chips and can always pay. The others start with 100 chips, and the most chips after the last round wins.
- **Checkers** (American draughts) against one NPC: forced captures, multi-jumps and kings.
- **Gomoku** against one NPC: five in a row on a 15 x 15 board.
- **Cribbage** against one NPC: fifteens, pairs and runs in the play and the show, first to 121.
- **Yacht** against one to three NPCs: five dice, up to three rolls a turn, twelve boxes to fill; the highest total wins.
- **Texas Hold'em** against one to three NPCs. No-limit, blinds of 5 and 10, 200 chips each; the most chips after the last hand (10 by default) or the last player with chips wins. How each opponent plays comes from their character: when the game starts, SkyrimNet reads their profile and decides whether they play tight or loose, bold or cautious, and how often they bluff. They talk the way they play.

When a game starts, your opponents come over to stand in front of you, and their faces are shown in frames on the board: drawn by Phantasm when it is installed, else cropped out of a screenshot.

### SkyrimNet

- **Commentary:** each moment of the game is told to one opponent, who reacts in their own words. Most games wait for each line to be spoken before the next move.
- **They know the game:** while they play, each opponent's prompt holds the state of the game (the `minigame_state` decorator). In Liar's Dice they see only their own dice, keep them secret, and may bluff. A Blackjack dealer alone knows their face-down card. A poker player knows their own cards and their own style.
- **You speak your own moves:** in Liar's Dice your bids and "Liar!" calls, and in Texas Hold'em your folds, checks, calls, bets and raises, are said by your character in their own words (MCM option).
- **Talk at the table:** type a line under the log and your character says it to one opponent, who alone answers, knowing the game (MCM option; Japanese, Chinese and Korean input needs Magelight UI).
- **Challenges:** an NPC may challenge you to Reversi in conversation (the action `Reversi_Challenge`); you can accept or decline.
- Opponents are marked busy while a game is played, so they are not pulled into other conversations.

### Requirements

| Mod | Notes |
|---|---|
| Skyrim SE / AE | Tested on 1.6.1170 |
| SKSE64 and Address Library | |
| Magelight UI 1.0 or later, **or** Prisma UI | Draws the board. One of the two is enough; with both, Magelight UI is used. Tested on Magelight UI 1.7.1 and Prisma UI 1.5.1 |
| SkyrimNet | Beta 28 or later |
| SkyUI and MCM Helper | Settings menu and hotkey |
| Phantasm 0.2.0 or later (optional) | Draws the opponents' faces with no screenshot; comes with SeverActions 4.7 or later. Without it, a screenshot is used |

### How to play

Press the hotkey (**K** by default) to open the menu, pick a game and your opponents, and play. The hotkey or **Esc** closes the board; an unfinished game is offered to continue the next time.

### Installation

Download the archive from the GitHub releases page and install it with your mod manager; the installer asks for the language of the board and the settings menu (English, Japanese, Russian, German or Simplified Chinese, independent of the game's language). `skyrimnet_MiniGame.esp` is ESL-flagged. Installing by hand: copy `core/<language>/` into Data.

Updating: install over the old mod. If you still have the separate Japanese translation mod of 0.3.0 or earlier, remove it; Japanese is one of the installer's choices.

### Notes

- Leave *Pause the game while playing* off: NPCs cannot speak while the game is paused.
- Liar's Dice and Texas Hold'em take their time: every bid is spoken. Each poker opponent's style costs one LLM request when the game starts; your own spoken moves cost one each.
- Without Phantasm, with ENB or Skyrim Upscaler installed there is no face photo, since saving it crashes the game; the frames show initials. With Phantasm the faces are drawn as usual. The MCM option *Face pictures* turns them off.
author: taka
changelog: Two new games. Yacht, against one to three NPCs: roll five dice up to three times a turn, keeping any between rolls, and score them in one of twelve boxes; after twelve rounds the highest total wins. An opponent speaks once or twice a round, and more on good rolls. Gomoku, against one NPC: free-style five in a row on a 15 x 15 board; the opponent speaks on fours, double threats and blocks. Each has an opponent strength in the MCM, and all new texts are in the installer's five languages.
